title: Moving house
instructions: İki arkadaş Kate ve Jim, Kate'in yeni evini konuşuyor. Uzun bir diyalog; eski ve yeni evi karşılaştır.

script.speaker: jim
script.text: Hi Kate! I heard you moved house. How's the new place?

script.speaker: kate
script.text: It's great, thanks. We moved last Saturday. It took all day!

script.speaker: jim
script.text: Is it bigger than your old flat?

script.speaker: kate
script.text: Yes, much bigger. The old flat had one bedroom. Now we have three.

script.speaker: jim
script.text: Wow! Is it in the city centre?

script.speaker: kate
script.text: No, it's about twenty minutes from the centre, but it's very quiet.

script.speaker: kate
script.text: Yes, a small one. The children love it. They play there every afternoon.

script.speaker: jim
script.text: And how do you get to work now?

script.speaker: kate
script.text: I take the train. Before, I walked to work, so that is the only bad thing.

script.speaker: jim
script.text: Are you going to have a party?

script.speaker: kate
script.text: Yes! Next Saturday. You must come. Bring your wife too!

questions.feedback: Geçen cumartesi (last Saturday) taşındılar. Gelecek cumartesi parti var.

questions.prompt: How many bedrooms does the new house have?
questions.feedback: Eski dairede bir yatak odası vardı; yeni evde üç (three).

questions.prompt: What is the bad thing about the new house?
options: Kate has to take the train to work.
questions.feedback: Önceden işe yürüyordu, şimdi trene binmesi gerekiyor; tek kötü yanı bu.
questions.evidence: so that is the only bad thing.
